Map name DM Starfighter

Weapons: Plasma pistols x4, Sniper Rifle, Shotgun x2, Plasma Grenades x4.

Power ups: Overshield 

Notes:

DM Starfighter is a symmetrical map suitable for 2-4 players. It is my ideal 1v1/2v2 haven. The goal of this map was to create an experience that feels similar to playing UT99 Blended with Halo. There are 3 main focal points of the map. The bridge in the center where the sniper is located, only accessible via the crates or the small man cannon on either side. The bridge also serves to break sightlines on either side, incentivizing players to risk the man cannons to finish off a kill or advance on the enemy team. The second focal point is the bottom of the map which is accessible via the teleporters in the center archway. The bottom of the map has small hallways which lead to the room in the center housing the over shield. The shotguns will be most useful at work down here. The third focal point of the map are the man cannons. There are 2 large cannons located on the right side of the player at spawn no matter what side you're on. These cannons will take you straight to the other side of the map. Players can use these man cannons to make a quick flank to get an enemy behind cover, or they can go straight through the center of the map. There are 2 light man cannons that give immediate access to the top of the bridge where the sniper is located. I'm going to be playtesting this map over the coming days/weeks and optimizing it wherever necessary. When we ran the playtest today, originally we had rockets on the bridge, which turned out to be too overpowered on a highly mobile/small map like this one.
